electrical_materials.notes: 300 K bulk reference. Masses follow the Ioffe x=0 alloy limit. Mobility is constant unless edited. No recombination, high-field transport or impurity-scattering model is implied.

electrical_materials.name: ITO

sources.title: Khusayfan & El-Nahass (2013): structure and electro-optical characteristics of ITO
sources.note: The paper uses assumed mass 0.35 m0 and reports process-dependent carrier density and mobility. Its measured optical band gap is not used as a universal electronic gap.

sources.title: Editable ITO device-study assumptions
sources.note: All preset values are model assumptions, not measurements of your film: n=8e20 cm−3, μn=30 cm²/(V·s), static εr=9, m*=0.35 m0, χ=4.5 eV, electronic gap=3.5 eV. Hole/DOS values are closure assumptions; degenerate ITO requires Fermi statistics.

electrical_materials.notes: Transparent conductor with degenerate electrons. Carrier density, mobility, static permittivity, mass and affinity depend on film growth; replace these assumptions with measured values. Static εr is not optical ε∞. The fixed mass approximation does not model nonparabolicity. Temperature is held constant in this preset.

electrical_materials.name: AlGaAs

sources.title: Ioffe NSM: AlGaAs band structure
sources.note: Piecewise 300 K fit. Indirect branch above x=0.45 uses DOS mass 0.85−0.14x and conductivity mass 0.26 m0.

sources.title: Editable transport assumptions
sources.note: 1000 / 100 cm²/(V·s) are starting estimates, not measured mobility for a particular alloy or doping.

electrical_materials.notes: Editable alloy fraction x∈[0,1]. The approximate direct/indirect transition is represented at x=0.45; Ioffe also reports a 0.41–0.45 crossover region. Mobility values are explicit assumptions. Temperature gaps use Varshni corrections and DOS scales as T^1.5; validity outside the 300 K reference must be assessed for the device.

electrical_materials.name: Silicon

sources.title: University of Colorado ECEE: silicon material parameters
sources.note: 300 K parameter sheet. ni is recalculated consistently from Eg/Nc/Nv rather than mixing independent rounded ni values.

sources.title: Ioffe NSM: silicon reference
sources.note: Conventional electron-affinity estimate 4.05 eV. Surface/interface processing can change the effective band alignment.

sources.title: Silicon temperature model
sources.note: Varshni α=4.73e−4 eV/K, β=636 K; DOS T^1.5 scaling. Static permittivity and mobility are held constant.

electrical_materials.notes: Crystalline silicon, 300 K low-field reference. Electron/hole conductivity masses are distinct from DOS masses. Mobility is not a fit to high doping or field; edit to match your sample.

electrical_materials.name: Air / void

sources.title: Ideal void model
sources.note: Vacuum-permittivity, zero-conductivity approximation.

electrical_materials.notes: Ideal dielectric void. No mobile carriers or optical material data are inferred from this record.

electrical_materials.name: Al2O3 unfitted static model
electrical_materials.notes: Reported 1017 nm TiN/Al2O3/TiN stack and nominal epsilon=9. The accessible primary text did not specify electrode area: 80×80 um is explicitly a normalization assumption, not the paper device footprint. Only near-zero static capacitance density is compared; 500 V leakage/breakdown is unsupported and exceeds the app 100 V input limit.
